final_text: {"proposed_outcome":"ESCALATE","findings":[{"text":"The event is an upload action.","evidence_id":"EVENT"},{"text":"The destination is a personal cloud-storage account hosted at onedrive.live.com.","evidence_id":"DESTINATION"},{"text":"The file is classified Confidential with category PII and high confidence.","evidence_id":"CLASSIFICATION"},{"text":"User behavior is in the ELEVATED band with a new_destination signal.","evidence_id":"BEHAVIOR"},{"text":"Policy service status was unavailable, so no deterministic policy claim was provided in the evidence pack.","evidence_id":"POLICY"},{"text":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account is prohibited.","evidence_id":"E1"},{"text":"Confidential and Restricted information must never be stored in personal cloud storage.","evidence_id":"E2"},{"text":"Confidential information may only be stored in company-managed systems approved by Information Security and must never be stored in personal accounts, including personal cloud-storage accounts.","evidence_id":"E3"},{"text":"No approved DLP exception exists for this user and destination covering this transfer.","evidence_id":"EXCEPTION"}],"missing_evidence":[]}
